profile.bio: I’m a Software Engineer and final-year Information Technology student at P.E.S. Modern College of Engineering, Pune. I specialize in building scalable backend systems, REST APIs, machine learning solutions, and AI-powered full-stack applications using Python, Node.js, Express, React, and MongoDB.
